# Tests
- `import { test, expect } from '<relative>/src/fixtures'` (only `tests/unit` and `tests/setup` use `@playwright/test`).
- Fixtures: `config`, `api`, `db`, `sf`, `testData`, `files`, `cleanup`, page objects. No selectors in specs; element assertions go through `pageObject.el.<name>.locator`.
- Arrange via `api`, act via page objects, assert in the UI **and** in the source of truth (`db` / `sf`). Register `cleanup.add(...)` right after creating data.
- Data-driven tests read validated data (`testData.excel/json/csv`). Tenant-specific data is keyed by tenant: never hard-code one tenant's values.
- Async backend effects: `db.waitFor` / `sf.waitFor` / `expect.poll`. Never `waitForTimeout`.
- Tags: `@ui @api @db @showcase @cura`; `@mutating` for anything that changes data (excluded in read-only envs).
- Folders: `tests/ui/<app>/`, `tests/api/`, `tests/db/`, `tests/showcase/`, `tests/unit/` (framework self-tests).
- Done = passes `--repeat-each=3 --retries=0` and `npm run verify`. Reference: `tests/showcase/master-showcase.spec.ts`.
